On an unstable uplink (phone hotspot, VPN over a flaky Wi-Fi, metro, laptop sleep/wake) Ouroboros stops being autonomous: a single transport interruption during an LLM call terminalizes the chat turn or the running task with `provider_unavailable`, and the owner has to notice and re-send by hand.
